lines.speaker: brask
lines.text: Gentlemen, the house welcomes the Sandman. Do you know what he was, before the grief made him dull?

lines.speaker: brask
lines.text: Twelve years the Conductor's best. Every man he visited went to sleep, and never woke. His favourite lullaby. Now you're just noise, Grave.

lines.speaker: brask
lines.text: I only place bets. The house sets the odds. Which of me will you hit?
